name: Lottie Player (play once)
description: Plays a Lottie (Bodymovin) JSON animation once and clears the screen by itself (zero-step graphic). Files with 'in'/'loop'/'out' markers play in, loop and out one time each; other files play from start to end. playAction resolves when the screen is clear, with currentStep undefined. Stop is optional and aborts the animation early (fade-out).

size.title: Size in % of the screen
size.description: The animation is fitted (keeping its aspect ratio) into a box of this size; 100 = full screen.

x.title: X position in % of screen width
x.description: Horizontal centre of the animation; 0 = left edge, 50 = centre, 100 = right edge.

y.title: Y position in % of screen height
y.description: Vertical centre of the animation; 0 = top edge, 50 = centre, 100 = bottom edge.

customActions.name: Restart
customActions.description: Play the animation once more from the start.
